activation_mail_pilot_shape_check.name: activation_mail_pilot_shape_check
activation_mail_pilot_shape_check.value:
(
    ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_id" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_user_id" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_outbox_id" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_armed_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_dispatch_used_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_closed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_id" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$' AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_user_id" = 1 AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_armed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_outbox_id" IS NULL OR "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_outbox_id" > 0)
      AND ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_dispatch_used_at" IS NULL OR ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_outbox_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_dispatch_used_at" >= "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_armed_at"))
      AND ("activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_closed_at" IS NULL OR "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_closed_at" >= "activation_mail_dispatch_control"."pilot_armed_at"))
  )

activation_mail_outbox_time_check.name: activation_mail_outbox_time_check
activation_mail_outbox_time_check.value: "activation_mail_outbox"."expires_at" > "activation_mail_outbox"."created_at" AND "activation_mail_outbox"."updated_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."created_at" AND ("activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NULL OR "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" < "activation_mail_outbox"."expires_at") AND ("activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NULL OR "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."created_at")

activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_fence_sh.name: activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_fence_shape_check
activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_fence_sh.value:
"activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at" IS NULL OR (
        "activation_mail_outbox"."state" IN ('in_flight', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'uncertain')
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 1
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at" < "activation_mail_outbox"."expires_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."updated_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at"
      )

activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_reservat.name: activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_reservation_shape_check
activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_reservat.value:
("activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_generation" IS NULL)
      OR (
        "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_generation" > 0
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."state" IN ('in_flight', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'uncertain')
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 1
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_fence_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" < "activation_mail_outbox"."expires_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."updated_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at"
      )

activation_mail_outbox_reservation_gener.name: activation_mail_outbox_reservation_generation_present_check
activation_mail_outbox_reservation_gener.value:
"activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" IS NULL
      OR "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_generation" IS NOT NULL

activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_start_sh.name: activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_start_shape_check
activation_mail_outbox_dispatch_start_sh.value:
"activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_started_at" IS NULL OR (
        "activation_mail_outbox"."state" IN ('in_flight', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'uncertain')
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 1 AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_generation" IS NOT NULL
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_generation" > 0
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_started_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_reservation_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_started_at" < "activation_mail_outbox"."expires_at"
        AND "activation_mail_outbox"."updated_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_started_at"
        AND ("activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NULL OR "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" >= "activation_mail_outbox"."dispatch_started_at")
      )

activation_mail_outbox_state_shape_check.name: activation_mail_outbox_state_shape_check
activation_mail_outbox_state_shape_check.value:
("activation_mail_outbox"."state" = 'ready' AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 0 AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("activation_mail_outbox"."state" = 'in_flight' AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 1 AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("activation_mail_outbox"."state" IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'uncertain') AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 1 AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("activation_mail_outbox"."state" = 'expired' AND "activation_mail_outbox"."attempt_count" = 0 AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activation_mail_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NULL)

comics_visibility_owner_check.name: comics_visibility_owner_check
comics_visibility_owner_check.value:
(
        ("comics"."visibility" = 'SHARED' AND "comics"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("comics"."visibility" = 'PRIVATE' AND "comics"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

community_comments_body_check.name: community_comments_body_check
community_comments_body_check.value: ("community_comments"."status" = 'REMOVED_BY_AUTHOR' AND "community_comments"."body" IS NULL AND "community_comments"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("community_comments"."status" <> 'REMOVED_BY_AUTHOR' AND char_length("community_comments"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND "community_comments"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "community_comments"."deleted_at" IS NULL)

community_comments_time_check.name: community_comments_time_check
community_comments_time_check.value: "community_comments"."updated_at" >= "community_comments"."created_at" AND ("community_comments"."edited_at" IS NULL OR "community_comments"."edited_at" >= "community_comments"."created_at") AND ("community_comments"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR "community_comments"."deleted_at" >= "community_comments"."created_at")

community_reports_resolution_check.name: community_reports_resolution_check
community_reports_resolution_check.value: ("community_comment_reports"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "community_comment_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("community_comment_reports"."status" <> 'OPEN' AND "community_comment_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

community_reviews_scores_check.name: community_reviews_scores_check
community_reviews_scores_check.value:
(
    ("community_reviews"."chapter_id" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_plot" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_characters" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_art" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_depth" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_world" IS NOT NULL
      AND "community_reviews"."rating_plot" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "community_reviews"."rating_characters" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "community_reviews"."rating_art" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "community_reviews"."rating_depth" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "community_reviews"."rating_world" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
    OR ("community_reviews"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating" IS NOT NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "community_reviews"."rating_plot" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_characters" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_art" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_depth" IS NULL AND "community_reviews"."rating_world" IS NULL))
